title: A name beneath a gallery print
passage:
DOCUMENT 1 — DISPLAY OFFICE | Lending and credit
A contributor may approve a photographed object for the gallery wall, the downloadable trail map, or both. Printed handouts stocked inside the gallery count as wall use. The map file uses the map permission even if a visitor downloads it while standing in the gallery.
For every photograph you use, copy the signed name field as written. If the field reads WITHHOLD, use the collection number below the print; do not put a name there.

DOCUMENT 2 — CONTRIBUTOR SIGN-OFF | Monday
P17, Street organ: wall and map. Signed name field: Mei Park.
P26, Ticket punch: wall only. Signed name field: WITHHOLD.
P32, Ferry clock: map only. Signed name field: V. Lo.
The first field in each entry is the collection number to use for the corresponding photograph. The wall and map entries above apply to the photographs, not to display of the original objects.

DOCUMENT 3 — EDITOR’S NOTE | Tuesday, 9:10 A.M.
The trail map and the paper handout currently use the same photograph: P26. Yesterday’s approval is still in force. Please change only the copy that cannot keep that photograph. For the replacement, use P32; the street organ photograph already appears elsewhere in that copy.
A detail for the handout: the draft still shows the ticket punch owner's name beneath the photograph. Please apply the credit rule before we print.
passageZh:
文件一：展覽辦公室｜借展與署名規則
提供者可同意讓物件的照片用在展廳牆面、可下載的導覽地圖，或同時用於兩者。展廳內供人索取的紙本資料視同牆面展示。即使訪客站在展廳內下載地圖檔，仍須依照地圖的使用許可。
每張使用的照片都要依照簽署欄內的姓名原樣照錄。如果欄內填的是 WITHHOLD（不公開），請在照片下方標示館藏編號，不要放上姓名。

文件二：提供者簽署表｜週一
P17，街頭手搖風琴：牆面與地圖皆可。簽署姓名欄：Mei Park。
P26，車票打孔器：僅限牆面。簽署姓名欄：WITHHOLD（不公開）。
P32，渡輪用時鐘：僅限地圖。簽署姓名欄：V. Lo。
每列開頭是相應照片使用的館藏編號。以上牆面與地圖的使用許可只適用於照片，不代表可以展示物件原件。

文件三：編輯備註｜週二上午 9:10
導覽地圖和紙本資料目前都使用 P26 這張照片。昨天的使用許可仍然有效。只有不能保留該照片的那一份需要換圖。請用 P32 替換；街頭手搖風琴的照片已出現在那一份的其他地方。
紙本資料還有一處要修正：草稿仍在照片下方印著打孔器所有者的姓名。印刷前請依署名規則處理。
